title: L3 Technical Engineer – Aruba ClearPass Network Access Control
description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**HPE Operations** 
 is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Key Technical Responsibilities**
**Aruba ClearPass NAC (Core)**
* Design, deploy, and operate Aruba ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM)
* Architect and support HA / DR ClearPass clusters
* Configure services, authentication sources ,authorization and enforcement policies
* Perform deep troubleshooting using Access. Tracker, Event Viewer, and system logs.


**Authentication \& Access Control**
* Implement and troubleshoot:
* 802\.1X (wired \& wireless)
* EAP\-TLS, PEAP, EAP\-TTLS.MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB)
* Hands\-on experience with RADIUS, TACACS\+, andCoA (RFC 3576\)
* Design role\-based and identity\-based access policies.


**Switch \& Network Integration**
* Integrate NAC with access switches (Aruba / Cisco / Juniper)
* Configure:
* DynamicVLAN assignment
* Downloadable User Roles (DUR)
* Troubleshoot switch\-side issues


 such as re\-auth loops and fail\-open/fail\-close scenarios
   

  

**Endpoint Security \& Posture**
* Configure and support ClearPass OnGuard posture checks
* Validate endpoint compliance.
* Antivirus / EDR (Trellix, Defender, CrowdStrike, etc.)
* OS patching, firewall, disk encryption
* Design quarantine and remediation workflows
* Support servers, core banking systems, ATMs, kiosks, and IoT devices


**Certificate \& Identity Integration**
* Implement certificate\-based authentication (EAP\-TLS)
* Integrate with Microsoft AD,LDAP, and AD CS (PKI)
* Troubleshoot certificate lifecycle issues (expiry, trust chain, CRL/OCSP)


**Operations \& Integrations**
* Act as L3 escalation point for NAC incidents
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for authentication and posture issues
* Integrate ClearPass with SIEM (Splunk/QRadar) and ITSM tools (BMC/ServiceNow)
* Plan and execute ClearPass upgrades and patching


**What You Need To Bring**
**Mandatory Technical Skills**
* Aruba ClearPass Policy Manager – Expert level
* NAC technologies: 802\.1X, RADIUS, TACACS\+, CoA
* Switch\-based NAC enforcement
* Endpoint posture (OnGuard)
* Certificate\-based authentication (EAP\-TLS)
* Windows AD, LDAP, DNS, NTP
* Strong troubleshooting and log analysis skills


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Banking / BFSI environment exposure
* SIEM / SOC integration experience
* REST API usage and automation
* SD\-WAN, VPN, or remote\-access NAC integration


**Experience \& Qualification**
* 6–10\+ years in Network Security / NAC
* 4\+ years hands\-on Aruba ClearPass experience
* Aruba certifications (ACSA / ACSP / ACCP) – preferred


**Role Type**
* Individual Contributor (L3 – Technical)
* High\-availability, production banking environment


**Accessibility**
 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
   

  

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
**Health \& Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal \& Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
   

  

**Let's Stay Connected**

title: Senior Project Delivery Manager, NVIS
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2023365
   

  

 Job Category Professional Services
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth technology organization? Are you excited to help enterprises build next\-generation digital infrastructures powered by cloud and accelerated computing? At NVIDIA, our team is passionate about parallel computing, visual computing, and AI infrastructure. We are advancing how computing solves the world’s most sophisticated challenges in science, industry, and enterprise. We are looking for driven, customer\-obsessed, and technically grounded leaders to help us capture once\-in\-a\-generation opportunities in AI and HPC.
   

  

 As a critical member of the NVIDIA Professional Services organization, you will serve as a Senior Service Delivery Manager leading end\-to\-end project delivery for enterprise data center environments. You will own the full project lifecycle from strategic alignment and solution design through deployment, stabilization, and production handover.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Build and maintain trusted, long\-term working relationships with customers, internal stakeholders, and partner teams.
* Understand high\-level and detailed technical architectures, facilitate technical discussions, and drive decision\-making for optimal solution design.
* Ensure project requirements, deliverables, and documentation adhere to NVIDIA quality standards and are completed on schedule.
* Develop, present, and defend comprehensive technical solutions and deployment plans to executive and technical customer audiences.
* Lead regular syncs, governance calls, and status updates with global internal teams, customers, and third\-party partners.
* Own delivery of complex on\-site or remote data center installations, escalate issues appropriately, and drive resolution with cross\-functional partners.
* Manage project change requests, release communications, and customer notifications in a clear and timely manner.
* Create clear, concise technical and operational runbooks, procedures, and post\-implementation documentation.
* Demonstrate flexibility to support on\-call, off\-hours, or global time zone requirements as needed for critical deployments.


**What We Need To See**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of progressive experience in project delivery management or customer service delivery leadership.
* 5\+ years of field service, customer implementation, or post\-sales support experience for enterprise hardware \& software platforms.
* Deep working knowledge of data center infrastructure: servers, storage, networking, cabling, power, cooling, and physical deployment workflows.
* Strong customer\-facing interpersonal skills and ability to engage directly with C\-level and technical stakeholders.
* Proven leadership experience across cross\-functional, global, and diverse teams.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to prioritize effectively, and manage multiple complex projects with minimal supervision.
* Experience leading global projects across regions and time zones.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Hands\-on experience with HPC clusters, InfiniBand, GPU infrastructure, or hyperscale data center technologies.
* Experience in AI infrastructure deployment, professional services, or tech vendor post\-sales delivery.

title: MS Specialist Radio
description:
**Job Description**
 As a RAN MS Specialist you should have

title: Engineer II - Field Service
description:
**Job Description**
**Brief Job Description:**
**Brief Job Description**
 Responsible for providing on\-site and remote technical support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, PDU (Power Distribution Units), STS (Static transfer Switches), AHF (Active Harmonic filters) and other similar Power electronics products. The role requires extensive knowledge of UPS systems, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team to ensure the reliability and performance of power systems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Support:


 Provide on\-site and remote support for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of UPS systems.
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network\-related issues affecting UPS performance.
   

  

 Assist in the configuration and commissioning of new UPS installations.
   

  

* Preventive Maintenance:


 Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance on UPS systems to ensure optimal performance.
   

  

 Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, including any repairs or replacements.
   

  

* Customer Interaction:


 Communicate effectively with customers to understand their needs and provide appropriate solutions.
   

  

 Train customers on the proper use and maintenance of UPS systems.
   

  

* Documentation and Reporting:


 Prepare detailed reports of service visits, including diagnostic findings, actions taken, and recommendations for future maintenance.
   

  

 Maintain up\-to\-date documentation of all service activities and customer interactions.
   

  

* Technical Training and Development:


 Stay current with the latest developments in UPS technology and industry best practices.
   

  

 Participate in ongoing training and professional development to enhance technical skills and knowledge.
   

  

* Compliance and Safety:


 Adhere to all safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards in all service activities.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education: Diploma/bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering/Electronics Engineering.
* Experience: Minimum of 8years of experience in UPS systems support or a related field.


 Experience with Vertiv Products is preferable.
   

  

* Technical Skills:


 Strong understanding of electrical and electronics principles and UPS technology.
   

  

 Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing UPS systems.
   

  

 Familiarity with network protocols and remote monitoring tools.
   

  

* Soft Skills:


 Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 The position may require travel to customer sites and may involve working in various environmental conditions.
   

  

 Flexibility to work outside regular business hours for emergency support and maintenance activities.
   

  

**Additional Requirements**
 Ability to travel as needed.
   

  

 Ability to lift and handle UPS components and equipment
   

  

 Same Posting Description for Internal and External Candidates
   

  

**About Us**
**The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles \& Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.**
**OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:** 
 Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.
   

  

**OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**
* High\-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength


**VERTIV BEHAVIORS**
* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer\-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent \& open communication


**About Vertiv**
 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.
